atAGlance: Trà xanh is green tea, grassy, lightly bitter, and clean when plain, but often sweetened on bottled or café menus.
whatItIs: Trà xanh is green tea served hot, iced, bottled, or café-style depending on the shop. Expect green tea that can taste grassy, lightly bitter, and clean, especially when served plain.
howToEnjoy: Ask whether it is sweetened if that matters; plain trà xanh and café trà xanh can taste very different.
howLocalsOrder: Trà xanh is ordered by temperature and sweetness. Ask ít đường or ít đá before the glass is made, because Vietnamese tea drinks can arrive sweeter and icier than expected.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Trà xanh helps you distinguish green tea from lotus, jasmine, peach, milk tea, and bottled sweet tea on Vietnamese menus.
goodToKnow: Ask for không đường if you want it unsweetened.
